'''Woulf''' is a costumer whose image is used on two [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards]].<ref name="cardlabels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images (res.starwarsccg.org). Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The cards print the credit as "Image courtesy of Woulf @ Rebel Legion". The credit points to the Rebel Legion, a Star Wars costuming club. The credited cards are [[Kit Fisto|•Kit Fisto]] and [[Kit Fisto (Holo AI)|•Kit Fisto (Holo AI)]], in [[Virtual Set 10]] (released 2019).
